protocol.source: Natural independently generated nature-phrase Japanese+arbitraryASCII code whole lines, not school subjects/names/rooms or existing main/development/final labels. Common baseline/relative heights/internal gaps retained. No CJK裁断, glyph crop, output repair or class-name whitelist.

protocol.negatives: Boundary clipping of20..40percent inkheight, interior glyph-region erasure with measured real ink removal, duplicated multiline, random strokes, and blank. Damaged/multiline/noise have no lost-fulltext CTC target; only reject BCE and teacher retention. Blank has empty CTC target to preserve empty decoding.
protocol.lossCompression: Training only: all ASCII95/blank and every training-target char plus one exact logsumexp of all unchanged other logits. OTHER never a target or inference class. Full CTC/teacherKL/gradients verified against18710 objective; original full18710 inference remains unchanged.
protocol.rejectPooling: Mean original frozen features whose temporal center lies within validWidth. Extra batch padding excluded. Real input padding is retained for CTC/teacherKL exactly as original. Source complete-ink/script proof remains independent and cannot be solved by crop head.
protocol.acceptance: Uncalibrated research diagnostic only: nonempty output, min emitted CTCconfidence>=.8, trained rejectProbability<=.05, all intervals within validWidth; original fallback has no trained reject gate. All original18710 output scalars retained, no ASCII-only routing.
protocol.selection: Original fallback included. Trained eligible only if mixed exact>=original, all-positive incorrectAccepted<=original, negativeAccepted<=original, and zero Japanese-retention regressions among original-correct rows. Maximum correctAccepted, then exact, lower incorrect/negativeAccepted, lower CER, earlier epoch. No test/oracle inference routing or repair.

Passing is research continuation only, not qualification.
